cards.title: Shell Clock Paper Frame
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable paper viewpoint card for telling a fictional tidepool lab moment from a shell clock's view: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, fold one paper frame, and choose a pretend lab object that gets to narrate: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: On paper, write what the shell clock notices before the lab helpers do: ____________________.
cards.firstViewPrompt: First view: The shell clock says, I notice ____________________.
cards.secondViewPrompt: Second view: The tide chart apprentice says, I notice ____________________.
cards.nearDetailPrompt: Near detail: Name one small mark beside the shell clock: ____________________.
cards.farDetailPrompt: Far detail: Name one pretend lab station across the page: ____________________.
cards.thoughtCluePrompt: Thought clue: What does the shell clock wonder about the changing water line? ____________________.
cards.reviseViewPrompt: Revise view: Change one sentence so it sounds more like a careful object narrator: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the shell clock first, then add one I notice line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Use another paper object to narrate a tiny lab moment: ____________________.

cards.title: Ferry Dock Double View
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable paper viewpoint card for rewriting one fictional ferry scene from two story roles: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw two paper docks, and choose one draft crossing for both roles: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write the scene once from the ferry guide's view, then again from the draft page's view: ____________________.
cards.firstViewPrompt: First view: The ferry guide sees the confusing sentence as ____________________.
cards.secondViewPrompt: Second view: The draft page sees the same crossing as ____________________.
cards.nearDetailPrompt: Near detail: Add one close paper ferry item, such as a pencil oar or note buoy: ____________________.
cards.farDetailPrompt: Far detail: Add one far draft island detail that changes the mood: ____________________.
cards.thoughtCluePrompt: Thought clue: What does the draft page hope will happen after the crossing? ____________________.
cards.reviseViewPrompt: Revise view: Keep the same event, but change whose eyes guide the sentence: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Circle one role and write only that role's view: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Fold a paper ferry and retell one scene from a new view: ____________________.

cards.title: Tower Label Watcher
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable paper viewpoint card for choosing which fictional clue a tower museum observer notices first: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, stack three blank paper labels, and invent one exhibit from ordinary pretend shapes: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write as a quiet observer who notices one clue without explaining everything at once: ____________________.
cards.firstViewPrompt: First view: The label keeper notices ____________________ before any other clue.
cards.secondViewPrompt: Second view: The tower visitor notices ____________________ instead.
cards.nearDetailPrompt: Near detail: Add one close label edge, smudge, color mark, or folded corner: ____________________.
cards.farDetailPrompt: Far detail: Add one high shelf, spiral step, or case shape across the page: ____________________.
cards.thoughtCluePrompt: Thought clue: What does the observer suspect the label is hiding? ____________________.
cards.reviseViewPrompt: Revise view: Remove one distracting detail and keep the clue the observer truly needs: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Mark only the clue the observer sees first: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Make one paper label and write what a careful observer notices: ____________________.

cards.title: Compass Mat Room Lens
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable paper viewpoint card for seeing a fictional academy scene through the setting first: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, sketch a compass mat and two path tiles, and pick the part of the room that shapes the scene: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Start with the place, then show how the compass apprentice acts inside that paper scene: ____________________.
cards.firstViewPrompt: First view: Through the setting lens, the map table makes the apprentice notice ____________________.
cards.secondViewPrompt: Second view: Through the apprentice's view, the map table feels like ____________________.
cards.nearDetailPrompt: Near detail: Add one close tool on the compass mat: ____________________.
cards.farDetailPrompt: Far detail: Add one far wall chart, thread rack, or path shelf on the paper scene: ____________________.
cards.thoughtCluePrompt: Thought clue: What choice does the apprentice think the setting is asking for? ____________________.
cards.reviseViewPrompt: Revise view: Move one setting detail earlier so it guides the action: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Label the setting first, then write one action beside it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Draw a tiny compass mat and write how the place changes a choice: ____________________.

cards.title: Ribbon Booklet Final View
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable paper viewpoint card for ending a fictional boardwalk booklet scene from the best final view: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, fold three pretend pages, and choose who gets the last view of the booklet: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write the ending from the role that can show the booklet is complete: ____________________.
cards.firstViewPrompt: First view: The page binder sees the final booklet as ____________________.
cards.secondViewPrompt: Second view: The ribbon keeper sees the same booklet as ____________________.
cards.nearDetailPrompt: Near detail: Add one close paper fold, ribbon loop, or cover mark: ____________________.
cards.farDetailPrompt: Far detail: Add one boardwalk table or display stand on the pretend page: ____________________.
cards.thoughtCluePrompt: Thought clue: What does the final viewer understand about what has changed? ____________________.
cards.reviseViewPrompt: Revise view: Choose the view that gives the clearest ending and cross out the weaker one: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Box the final-view sentence before adding any other detail: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Fold a paper booklet and write one closing view for its last page: ____________________.
